references.text: The description of the bronze altar and its equipment, including the grating and the carrying poles, which are here delivered as finished work.
The actual making of the bronze altar with its grating, carrying poles, and all the utensils mentioned in this verse.
God's command to make the basin (the laver) of bronze with its stand, which the priests were to use for washing themselves.
The making of the bronze basin and its stand, made from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting.
The instruction to place the bronze altar in front of the entrance to the tabernacle and set the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar.
The fulfillment of the command where Moses sets up the bronze altar and the basin in their proper places.
Reference to the tabernacle and all the vessels for service that were sprinkled with blood, which includes the objects mentioned here.
A direct parallel between the instruction (35:16) and its fulfillment (39:39), emphasizing perfect obedience in the work on the sanctuary.
Connects God's original instructions (31:9) with their actual execution (39:39), showing continuity in the construction of the sanctuary.
Refers back to the specific list of holy utensils (30:28) that were completed in chapter 39.
Fills out the details about the production of the bronze altar (38:30) which are summarized in the final overview in 39:39.
